name: Sarah Mitchell
title: Dr.
bio: Dr. Sarah Mitchell is an accomplished consultant psychiatrist recognised for her expertise in early psychosis care and her commitment to improving outcomes for young people experiencing emerging mental health difficulties.
expertise: Her clinical expertise spans mood disorders, psychosis, and complex co-occurring conditions, with a strong emphasis on delivering evidence-based, compassionate care
achievements: In her career, Dr. Sarah Mitchell has been recognised for her leadership and innovation in mental health services. In 2022, she received the NHS Innovation Award for her pioneering work in developing early-stage psychosis pathways that improved access to care for young people. The year prior, she was honoured with the Royal College of Psychiatrists Clinical Excellence Commendation, acknowledging her consistently high standards of patient-centred practice. Her contributions to service development were further highlighted in 2020 when she earned the UK Mental Health Service Leadership Award for guiding multidisciplinary teams through complex transformational projects. Earlier in her career, her research in early intervention earned her the Early Intervention in Psychosis Research Prize in 2019, followed by the National Collaborative Care Improvement Award in 2018, recognising her commitment to integrated, evidence-based models of care.

name: James Thompson
title: Dr.
bio: Dr. James Thompson is a clinical psychologist with 12 years of experience in NHS mental health services. He trained at the University of Sheffield and completed his doctorate in Clinical Psychology at Leeds, specializing in evidence-based psychological therapies for adults experiencing anxiety and mood difficulties.
expertise: James is an expert in cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) and has additional training in acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT), compassion-focused therapy, and EMDR for trauma. He takes a collaborative approach, working alongside patients to understand their unique experiences.
expertise_tags: CBT, ACT, Anxiety Disorders, OCD, Depression
achievements: He was awarded the British Psychological Society's Early Career Award in 2018 for his research on improving CBT outcomes. James has trained over 50 junior psychologists and therapists in evidence-based interventions.
publications: Living with Anxiety: A Practical Guide Using ACT Principles

name: Priya Patel
title: Dr.
bio: Dr. Priya Patel is a consultant psychiatrist who leads the Early Intervention in Psychosis (EIP) team. She qualified from the University of Birmingham Medical School and completed her psychiatry training in the West Midlands before joining Sheffield in 2016.
expertise: Dr. Patel specializes in first-episode psychosis and has expertise in culturally sensitive mental health care. She is fluent in Gujarati, Hindi, and Urdu, allowing her to connect with patients from diverse backgrounds.
expertise_tags: Early Psychosis, Cultural Psychiatry, Family Therapy, Recovery-Focused Care
achievements: She has published influential research on improving access to mental health services for South Asian communities and was shortlisted for the BME Health Professional of the Year Award in 2021.
publications: Research on cultural barriers to mental health care

name: Michael O'Brien
title: Mr.
bio: Michael O'Brien is an Advanced Mental Health Nurse Practitioner with over 22 years of experience in psychiatric nursing. He began his career at the Maudsley Hospital in London before moving to Sheffield in 2008.
expertise: As a qualified non-medical prescriber, Michael specializes in medication management, physical health monitoring, and recovery-focused care. He coordinates the depot clinic and leads the team's physical health initiative.
expertise_tags: Medication Management, Physical Health, Recovery Model, Depot Clinic
achievements: Michael received the Chief Nursing Officer's Award for Excellence in 2019 for his work improving physical health outcomes in patients with serious mental illness.
publications: Michael O'Brien is an experienced consultant psychiatrist specialising in acute and crisis care, known for his calm, decisive approach in high-pressure clinical settings.

name: Emma Wilson
title: Dr.
bio: Dr. Emma Wilson is a specialty registrar in her final year of psychiatry training. She studied medicine at Newcastle University and has worked across various mental health settings including inpatient wards, community teams, and liaison psychiatry.
expertise: Emma has a keen interest in perinatal mental health and digital innovations in healthcare. She completed a special interest module in mother and baby psychiatry at the Bethlem Royal Hospital.
expertise_tags: Perinatal Mental Health, Digital Health, Quality Improvement, Liaison Psychiatry
achievements: Emma led the development of this Walking Waiting Room app as part of her quality improvement portfolio, winning the Trainee Innovation Prize at the Yorkshire regional conference.
publications: Dr. Emma Wilson is a respected consultant psychiatrist known for her compassionate approach and strong commitment to improving community mental health care.
